source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 21 May 1952 p10: Mr. S. J. Davison ... was not nominated ... defeated by Mr. H. J. Cousley, M.B.E. (OCR 'Coualey').

note: Triennial election of the 26 electoral divisions of Magherafelt rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-five members were returned unopposed; the only contest was at Newbridge, where the outgoing Nationalist held the seat. The other twenty-three divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 14 June 1952, p. 7), which lists all 26 divisions (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). In place of Mr. S. J. Davison, chairman for 15 years, who was defeated for nomination. Returned unopposed.
